headline: Atlantic Union Bankshares Executive Vice President Sells Common Stock
summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares executive vice president Linderman sold $309,840 in common stock.
why: Executive stock sales provide market participants with disclosures regarding senior management liquidity actions and equity ownership levels.

impacts.name: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp
